name: epa-mcp-server
description: Access EPA environmental data — facility compliance (ECHO), toxic releases (TRI), Superfund sites, drinking water systems, and real-time air quality (AirNow) via MCP.

AIRNOW_API_KEY.title: AirNow API Key
AIRNOW_API_KEY.description: Optional. Enables the epa_get_air_quality tool when set; the other tools work without it. Free registration at docs.airnowapi.org.

EJSCREEN_API_BASE_URL.title: EJScreen (EJAM) API Base URL
EJSCREEN_API_BASE_URL.description: Optional. Override the EJScreen data endpoint used by epa_get_ejscreen. Defaults to https://api.ejanalysis.com — the community-maintained EJScreen rehost by Public Environmental Data Partners.
